source_evidence.establishes: fresh run_config construction, factory creation, initial-guidance seeding before factory.run, and no resume/import in the Stage 4 protocol
the solver population, optimizer population, and solver workspace builder are all constructed before the loop begins
each population owns a random.Random stream but upstream supplies no config seed
worker selection owns a third random.Random stream
produce_optimizer_in_phase2 is passed into every iteration and the same iteration budget applies to all conditions
value zero prevents optimizer construction/addition; value one admits only changed guidance; all population/prefill sampling consumes the seeded streams

condition_semantics.static: Seed one optimizer from an empty runtime directory and set produce_optimizer_in_phase2=0. The solver receives an empty guidance tree and no changed guidance can enter the optimizer population.
condition_semantics.fixed: Seed the frozen route guidance and set produce_optimizer_in_phase2=0. Every iteration may solve candidates, but changed workspace guidance cannot become an optimizer candidate.
condition_semantics.evolved: Seed the same frozen route guidance and set produce_optimizer_in_phase2=1. A guidance tree enters the optimizer population only when it differs from the working optimizer, after which later sampling can select it.

rng_semantics.seed_timing: immediately after EveFactory.from_config and before seed_initial_guidance/factory.run
rng_semantics.claim_boundary: Pairing controls EvE sampling only. Codex/provider sampling remains an independent, unseeded source of run-to-run variation and is never described as deterministic.
